Native first-error aborts establish observed diagnostics, not exhaustive semantic coverage. Go execution byte columns are bounded, not independently attested exactly.
Release signatures and complete publisher/license/container closure remain unverified. Artifact hashes and observed members are separate evidence.
Receipt coherence and current source are not hostile-project attestation or AI host session independence.
Resource bounds apply to this controller, excluding host wrappers and other host work; representative CPU/RSS/archive measurements remain pending.
